summary: RUPTURE is a monophonic bass synth built around Cycle Exchange Synthesis (CXS) or a bandlimited saw, with two sub-oscillators, a step sequencer and arpeggiator, and 1-bit animated screens.
features: Main oscillator switches between CXS and a bandlimited SAW
Two sub-oscillators with type, octave, detune, drift and blend
Resonant filter, ADSR, LFO, sound-shape controls and channel EQ
Eight effects, including spring, hall and room reverbs
Sequencer with overdub, count-in, hold and locks; eight named sequences
Guided first-run setup and a 43-screen on-device tour
